_comment: 短文理解のレベル別 情景絵。level: semantic=意味(非可逆文) / reversible=語順(可逆文) / particle=助詞(受動・使役) / relative=関係節。pairs は選択肢に必ず混ぜる対の絵(カードid)。image を持つカードは既存の絵を使う(受動文は能動文の絵を流用)ので画像生成は不要。画像を images/scene/<id>.png に生成・最適化したあと `node scripts/merge-pending.mjs` で取り込む。
prompt_template: {english_prompt}, simple scene illustration on a pure white background, flat illustration style. Style: clean, educational illustration for speech therapy materials; every character must be clearly recognizable and it must be unmistakable who is doing what to whom. Keep the same character designs across the paired pictures. Colors: soft, natural. Composition: only the characters and the objects needed for the action, at most a thin ground line, no other background, no text, no speech bubbles, no logos. Aspect ratio: 1:1.
